description: Update gas estimates for an existing transaction. For multisig, run this when one signer remains: it rotates the signingHash to the one the last signer must sign, including on a signer or network change proposal. The response's gasEstimates is null for those proposals, whose gas is estimated per network.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: transactions_update-gas-estimation
